newsitem.title: FRANCE: Timetable for Izetbegovic-Milosevic Paris talks.
newsitem.headline: Timetable for Izetbegovic-Milosevic Paris talks.

text.p: Bosnian Moslem President Alija Izetbegovic and President Slobodan Milosevic of Serbia will meet in Paris at 1000 a.m. (0800 GMT) on Thursday, France's foreign ministry said on Tuesday.

The meeting in the Hotel Marigny residence, first announced last month, will be followed by lunch at the nearby presidential Elysee Palace with President Jacques Chirac and Carl Bildt, Swedish chief international civilian representative in Bosnia, and French Foreign Minister Herve de Charette.
The Izetbegovic-Milosevic talks are to discuss building peace after Bosnia's elections and normalising relations between the two countries, French officials said.
The visitors will arrive separately in Paris late on Wednesday, officials said. No further details were immediately available.
